_meta.ptally/summary: Changes a saved quote's price (or whether it is valid, or sold), with a reason. The change is logged under your name with the time; the engine's original price is kept. A sold quote is locked: mark it unsold first to change it.

description:
Amend a SAVED quote (a quote_reference from get_quotes): its price (`result`), and optionally `valid` or `sold`, with a required `reason`. Logged in the quote's audit trail under the signed-in user, with the time, the old and new values, source "mcp" and the reason. The engine's own result, valid and output are never changed — the amended values sit beside them, and setting price or validity back to the engine's value clears that amendment (still logged).

BEFORE CALLING
1. Call get_quote (or get_quotes) for the quote's current price, validity and sold flag.
2. Tell the user exactly what will change (old → new) and the reason that will be logged, and get their go-ahead.

RULES
- At least one of result, valid, sold, and each must differ from what the quote is now (else an error says nothing changed).
- result is a number; valid and sold are booleans; reason is a non-empty sentence.
- A sold quote is locked. The only change it accepts is `sold: false` on its own (marking it unsold, with a reason); after that it can be amended and marked sold again — three calls, each logged. Check get_quote first, and tell the user when a change means unselling the quote. A price change can go in the same call that marks it sold.
- Refused in read-only mode.

RESULT
{ quote_reference, engine: { result, valid }, now: { result, valid, sold }, amended, logged: { amendment_reference, by, at, source, result: { from, to }, valid, sold, reason }, quote_url, next_steps }.

quote_reference.description: The saved quote to amend, from get_quotes.

reason.description: Required on every call: why the price (or validity, or sale) is changing, in the user's words, e.g. "Quote amendment: agreed 5% discount". Logged with the change, who made it and when.

result.description: The new price. Only on a quote that isn't sold — mark a sold quote unsold first.

sold.description: Optional. true marks it sold and locks it (a price change can go in the same call). false, sent on its own, marks a sold quote unsold so it can be changed.

valid.description: Optional. Whether the quote is now valid. Only on a quote that isn't sold.

name: amend_quote
title: Amend a quote
